Which Rows Carry a Level Nobody Will See

Source: R/analysis_pipeline.R
ck_level_is_redundant.Rd

A row's level asks for a confidence interval, and the interval only reaches the output through stat_low / stat_upp in value_columns. Where neither is asked for, the survey engine would compute an interval and discard it, so under engine = "auto" the row is tabulated instead.

Usage

ck_level_is_redundant(analysis_type, supplied, value_columns, engine = "auto")

Arguments

analysis_type

Character vector of analysis types.

supplied

Logical vector: was a level supplied for the row.

value_columns

The statistic columns the run reports.

engine

"auto", "fast" or "survey".

Value

A logical vector, TRUE for each row to tabulate in the survey engine's layout.

Details

Medians and ratios stay on the survey engine whatever value_columns says: the survey median interpolates where the fast one reports an observed value, and the two engines describe a ratio's counts differently, so moving either could change a number in the workbook.
